name: 33701 · St Petersburg, FL
findings: ZIP 33701 (St Petersburg) has 184 nonprofit organizations. 82 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (10% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33701 (St Petersburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 20 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
